intro: Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
chorus: Yummy, yummy, yummy in my tummy,
Fruit is sweet and fruit is funny!
Crunch it, munch it, one, two, three,
Yummy fruit for you and me!
verses: Rory picks a banana, long and yellow,
Peel it, peel it, what a funny fellow!
Banana for Rory, yum yum yummy!
Little seeds on top, she said!
Strawberries for Ziggy, yum yum yummy!
Waffles picks a big green apple,
Crunch, crunch, crunch, he gives a chuckle!
Apple for Waffles, yum yum yummy!
Tiny and round, he eats a few!
Blueberries for Pebble, yum yum yummy!
bridge: Fruit makes us strong and fruit makes us merry!
Rub your tummy, yum yum yummy!
